subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw define a new core session-level process/step event contract now, and what payload, replay, authorization, and redaction rules should it have?
rationale: This is a new core event contract with security-sensitive intermediate run state, not a narrow repair of existing documented behavior.

options.title: Design the canonical core contract
options.body: Approve a bounded design pass for additive process/step events, including replay, ordering, authorization, redaction, and UI/SDK consumers before implementation.

options.title: Extend existing item/session streams
options.body: Keep the event vocabulary smaller by evolving `item`, `plan`, and `session.tool` semantics instead of introducing `process.*` and `step.*` families.

options.title: Defer the new contract
options.body: Leave related progress gaps to narrower issues until a maintainer sponsors a broader process-system direction.

recommendation.title: Design the canonical core contract
recommendation.body: Approve a bounded design pass for additive process/step events, including replay, ordering, authorization, redaction, and UI/SDK consumers before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans gateway protocol, event coverage, and product/security direction, and the available history points to adjacent gateway event ownership.
